summary: PLDT Inc. furnished a Form 6-K attaching its Philippine Stock Exchange and SEC disclosures (PSE Form 4-9 and SEC Form 17-C) dated November 2, 2026, concerning the resignation and replacement of the Company's external auditor. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics were disclosed; the filing is an ordinary audit-firm change reported under Section 17.1(b) of the Philippine Securities Regulation Code. No special-situation event, no regulatory clock, and no arbitrage angle arise; the disclosure carries no deal terms and no risk-arb implications.
